verdict.rationale: smolagents offers building blocks a lead could use to insert human oversight: agents can be run one step at a time via agent.step(), step callbacks can intervene in agent memory, and custom tools define their own forward() code where a gate could be added. None of this is a documented approval mechanism for specific tool calls, and step-level control acts between steps rather than before an individual tool executes. Missing for 10: a native per-tool approval/confirmation gate, a pre-execution hook for tool calls, a policy for marking tools as sensitive, and any docs or hands-on corroboration of a human-approval workflow.
